body_lead: Bengaluru: State school education department is planning to rope in the country's leading tech institutes â either IIT Madras or IIT Bombay â to develop a computer science curriculum for govt-run Karnataka Public Schools (KPS). The department plans to introduce computer science as a subject for students starting in class 1 in the 2026-27 academic year. This initiative will also include the incorporation of Artificial Intelligence from class 3 onward and the establishment of a dedicated group of qualified computer science teachers.
